summary: Generate and independently verify three dedicated HomeBrain sensor motherboards with factory-header through-hole footprints, routed copper, draft Gerbers under manufacturing HOLD, BOMs, and assembly sheets.
outputs: One separate Gerber ZIP, checked layout, assembly BOM, assembly PNG/SVG, schematic PNG/SVG, and actual-size SVG fit template for each Atmosphere, Presence, and Climate motherboard, plus a fleet order list and hash manifest.
side_effects: Replaces only generated motherboard artifacts under hardware/homebrain-sensors/motherboards/generated/.
